evidence_slice: Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council's planning guidance lists the Bassingthorpe Farm Supplementary Planning Document as adopted in September 2025. The Council's Annual Monitoring Report identifies Bassingthorpe Farm as a Strategic Allocation in the adopted Core Strategy, anticipates around 2,400 new homes and around 10 hectares of employment land, and directs to Core Strategy Policy CS1 for delivery of the strategic allocation.
